kjv: Have ye received the Holy Ghost since ye believed?
mine: Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you believed?
note: The aorist participle "pisteusantes" is coincident with the main verb ("when you believed"); "since" implies a later, second experience and has been used to support that doctrine.
The KJV uses the Roman name Diana for the Ephesian Artemis, a very different deity in cult and image. Throughout 19:24–35.

kjv: which are neither robbers of churches
note: hierosylos is a temple robber; "churches" is anachronistic for a pagan temple.
